text.part: These answers are based on the Fitzpatrick scale, a widely recognised medical classification scheme for skin colour.
To help our Dermatology Clinicians prescribe your treatment accurately and safely.

inputConfig.instruction: Drag the slider to the shade closest to your skin

options.label: Pale
options.value: Pale. It always burns, never tans

options.description: It often burns, but tans a little
options.label: Fair
options.value: Fair. It often burns, but tans a little

options.label: Darker shade of pale
options.value: Darker shade of pale. It sometimes burns, tans evenly

options.label: Light brown
options.value: Light brown. It burns minimally, tans easily

options.description: It very rarely burns, tans darkly easily
options.label: Brown
options.value: Brown. It very rarely burns, tans darkly easily

options.label: Dark brown or black
options.value: Dark brown or black. It always tans darkly
